summary: Tested the production build end to end (backend pytest: 28 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_mauli_prod.py; Playwright UI at 1920, 412 and 360 px). The reported eslint bug is FIXED: the frontend compiles with warnings only, no overlay, and /enquiry and /product/<slug> render. Working: Owner forced password change (API 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED, then change, UI force-password-change screen), staff/delivery/manager role permissions and UI redirects, delivery sees only assigned orders, Integrations page (6 'Not configured' + google/maps connected, EN+MR help), xlsx exports, OTP 503 plus login notice and Google button, no '123456'/demo text, online payment hidden, guest COD order via UI and COD/store/customer orders via API, invoice/packing PDFs, /pay/demo 404, cross-customer order 403, concurrent last-unit (exactly 1 of 4 succeeds), cancel restock (no double restock), POS stock decrement/oversell block, forward-only status, return approve->refunded, refund of cancelled+paid order (API+UI), uploads 503/400 (type, size), product via image URL, CRUD (coupons/pincodes/slots/banners), bulk CSV, bulk edit, stock adjust/movements/valuation, reviews/QA/enquiry moderation, broadcast logs 'skipped: ... not configured', reports json/xlsx/pdf, Settings changes reflected in header/footer/showroom/privacy, map and WhatsApp FAB hidden when empty, search suggest and typo tolerance, sort, infinite scroll, wishlist, compare, language toggle, account and delete account, NoSQL-injection params, brute-force lockout (5x401 then 429), bcrypt $2b$, health/HSTS/CSP on API, sitemap/manifest/sw.js, no horizontal overflow at 360/412. 2 backend bugs found (stock leak on rejected razorpay order; 500 on non-numeric page).

critical.issue: Stock leaks. In create_order, stock is taken off via adjust_stock BEFORE the razorpay_keys() check (and before rzp_order). The 400 'Online payment is not available' (and any 502 gateway error) is raised with no rollback, so stock is permanently reduced and a 'sale' stock_movement is written with no order. Anyone can drain inventory by POSTing razorpay orders while Razorpay is not configured. Reproduced: product stock 2 -> 1 after a rejected request.

minor.issue: 500 ValueError from int(a.get('page')) in routes_store.products. Should be 400/422 or clamp to defaults.

Stock is checked with a plain read, then the order is inserted, and adjust_stock is called last without checking its return value. A concurrent sale of the last unit gives a recorded POS order with no stock decrement and no error.
The check-then-update is not atomic (adjust_stock only guards stock>=qty for type 'sale'), so concurrent adjustments can push stock negative.
Staff role (ALL) can set payment_status to paid/refunded/refund_pending directly, which skips the refund flow and its manager permission. Also there is no 404 for an unknown id (returns null).
p['images'][0] raises IndexError (500) if any active product has an empty images list. Admin ProductIn allows images=[].
Does not check that the product exists, so orphan questions can be created.

No check that price <= mrp. Seed product 'Royal Teak 3 Seater Sofa' (MFM-SOF-1000) currently has price 813098 and mrp 49999. Data defect, most likely from an earlier bulk price edit; not caused by this run.
The owner can change their own role or another account's role to a non-owner role, which can leave the store with no owner.

ui_bugs.issue: For cancelled orders the Timeline component shows only a 'Cancelled' box. The placed/confirmed history and the 'by' audit data are hidden from admins.

issues: Delivery date uses the browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar
City/State/Email (optional) labels are English in Marathi mode
The subtitle 'OTP ने सुरक्षित लॉगिन करा' still promotes OTP even though OTP is disabled
The top bar says 'सुरक्षित पेमेंट' and the PDP EMI box says 'UPI, cards, net banking & wallets accepted' while online payment is not configured. This is misleading.
Titles are auto-capitalized keys ('Sms Otp', 'Push Fcm', 'Whatsapp Api', '(.Xlsx)'). Use proper labels: SMS OTP, Push (FCM), WhatsApp API, .xlsx
Enquiry label 'Furniture type (Sofa, Bed...)' and Account 'No orders yet' are not translated in MR
Delete account uses a native window.confirm instead of a styled dialog
Admin orders table has no empty-state text
Product cards show a '0 ★' badge for unrated products
data-testid 'header-logo' is duplicated in the footer

action_items: routes_orders.create_order: when payment_method=='razorpay', validate razorpay_keys() BEFORE the stock-deduction loop. Wrap rzp_order in try/except and roll back stock (adjust_stock +qty 'return') on any failure.
routes_store.products: parse page/limit safely (try/except, default 1/12) to avoid 500
POS sale: deduct stock atomically first (adjust_stock returns None means 400 plus rollback), then insert the order
stock_adjust: use a conditional atomic update ({'stock': {'$gte': qty}}) for out/damage
Restrict payment_status edits in PUT /admin/orders to owner/manager
Guard suggest against empty images; validate price <= mrp; fix the Royal Teak sofa price (813098 > MRP 49999)
Frontend: shadcn calendar for delivery date, fix the misleading OTP/payment copy, and the missing MR translations
Optional hardening: CSP/HSTS are only set on /api responses. The storefront HTML has no CSP/HSTS headers; add a CSP meta tag in public/index.html or configure it at the hosting layer.
critical_code_review_comments: create_order raises HTTPException after mutating stock (razorpay branch). Any post-deduction exception must compensate.
The customer JWT is stored in localStorage (mfm_token), not an httpOnly cookie. Acceptable with a strict CSP, but the storefront has no CSP.
PUT /admin/settings does a $set of the raw body (owner only): any arbitrary key can be persisted. Whitelist the keys.
Deleting a product leaves orphan stock_movements, reviews and questions.
cancel_and_restock is not idempotent under concurrency: two simultaneous cancels can both pass the status check and restock twice. Use a conditional update on status first.

rca of the issue: Stock leak: routes_orders.py lines 142-154. The loop calls adjust_stock(-qty) for each line, then the `if body.payment_method == 'razorpay'` branch calls razorpay_keys(); with no keys it raises HTTPException(400) without rolling back `done`. Repro: POST /api/orders {items:[{product_id, qty:1}], address, pincode:'411001', payment_method:'razorpay'} gives 400, but the product stock drops by 1. Fix: move the key check above the loop, and wrap rzp_order in try/except with the same rollback used for out-of-stock.
